metadata.description: Centralized AI prompts for BrowserFrontEnd project
metadata.author: BrowserFrontEnd Team

projectContext.role: You are an AI assistant helping with a modern frontend web application called BrowserFrontEnd.
projectContext.design_system: Purple gradient theme (#667eea to #764ba2), responsive design, modern web standards
projectContext.code_style: Clean, semantic HTML, mobile-first CSS, vanilla JavaScript with ES6+ features

codeReview.role: You are a senior frontend developer reviewing code for best practices, performance, and maintainability.
codeReview.criteria: Check for: semantic HTML, efficient CSS, modern JavaScript patterns, accessibility, responsive design, browser compatibility
codeReview.standards: Follow web standards, use semantic elements, ensure mobile-first approach, optimize for performance

debugging.role: You are a debugging expert helping to identify and fix issues in frontend web applications.
debugging.approach: Analyze symptoms, check browser console, validate HTML/CSS/JS, test responsiveness, verify cross-browser compatibility
debugging.tools: Browser dev tools, validators, lighthouse, accessibility checkers

featureRequest.template: I need to add {feature_name} to the BrowserFrontEnd project. The feature should {description}. Please consider: 1) HTML structure, 2) CSS styling matching our purple gradient theme, 3) JavaScript functionality, 4) Responsive design, 5) Accessibility.

examples.contact_form: I need to add a contact form to the BrowserFrontEnd project. The feature should allow users to send messages with name, email, and message fields. Please consider: 1) HTML structure, 2) CSS styling matching our purple gradient theme, 3) JavaScript functionality, 4) Responsive design, 5) Accessibility.
examples.image_gallery: I need to add an image gallery to the BrowserFrontEnd project. The feature should display images in a responsive grid with lightbox functionality. Please consider: 1) HTML structure, 2) CSS styling matching our purple gradient theme, 3) JavaScript functionality, 4) Responsive design, 5) Accessibility.

optimization.performance: Analyze the BrowserFrontEnd project for performance improvements. Focus on: loading speed, CSS efficiency, JavaScript optimization, image optimization, and overall user experience.
optimization.accessibility: Review the BrowserFrontEnd project for accessibility compliance. Check: ARIA labels, keyboard navigation, color contrast, semantic HTML, screen reader compatibility.
optimization.seo: Evaluate the BrowserFrontEnd project for SEO best practices. Examine: meta tags, semantic structure, page titles, descriptions, structured data opportunities.

refactoring.template: Refactor the {file_name} in the BrowserFrontEnd project to improve {aspect}. Maintain the existing functionality while enhancing {goals}. Keep the purple gradient design theme consistent.

copywriting.website_copy: Generate engaging copy for the BrowserFrontEnd website sections. Tone: modern, professional, friendly. Focus on: clear value propositions, user benefits, call-to-actions that convert.
copywriting.technical_docs: Create clear technical documentation for the BrowserFrontEnd project. Style: concise, well-structured, includes examples, suitable for developers of all levels.
copywriting.user_guides: Write user-friendly guides for BrowserFrontEnd features. Style: step-by-step, visual descriptions, beginner-friendly, include common troubleshooting.

metadata.page_titles: Generate SEO-optimized page titles for BrowserFrontEnd pages. Requirements: under 60 characters, include relevant keywords, compelling and descriptive.
metadata.descriptions: Create meta descriptions for BrowserFrontEnd pages. Requirements: 150-160 characters, include key features, compelling call-to-action.
metadata.alt_text: Generate descriptive alt text for images in BrowserFrontEnd. Be specific, concise, and helpful for screen readers while being SEO-friendly.

codeReview.security: Perform a security review of the BrowserFrontEnd code. Check for: XSS vulnerabilities, input validation, secure coding practices, potential security risks.
codeReview.performance: Analyze BrowserFrontEnd performance. Examine: load times, resource optimization, rendering efficiency, JavaScript execution, CSS efficiency.
codeReview.compatibility: Review BrowserFrontEnd for cross-browser compatibility. Test considerations: modern browsers, mobile devices, accessibility features, progressive enhancement.

userExperience.usability: Evaluate BrowserFrontEnd user experience. Focus on: navigation clarity, content hierarchy, user flow, interaction feedback, error handling.
userExperience.mobile: Assess BrowserFrontEnd mobile experience. Check: responsive design, touch interactions, loading speed, readability, mobile-specific features.
userExperience.conversion: Analyze BrowserFrontEnd for conversion optimization. Review: call-to-actions, user journey, friction points, trust signals, engagement elements.

scenarios.functionality: Create test scenarios for BrowserFrontEnd features. Include: happy path tests, edge cases, error conditions, user interaction flows.
scenarios.responsive: Generate responsive design test cases for BrowserFrontEnd. Test: various screen sizes, orientation changes, touch interactions, browser zoom levels.
scenarios.accessibility: Develop accessibility test procedures for BrowserFrontEnd. Cover: keyboard navigation, screen readers, color contrast, focus management.

automation.unit_tests: Suggest unit test cases for BrowserFrontEnd JavaScript functions. Focus on: input validation, utility functions, event handlers, data processing.
automation.integration: Recommend integration test scenarios for BrowserFrontEnd components. Test: component interactions, data flow, API integrations, user workflows.

checklist.pre_deploy: Create pre-deployment checklist for BrowserFrontEnd: code review complete, tests passing, performance optimized, accessibility verified, documentation updated.
checklist.post_deploy: Generate post-deployment verification steps for BrowserFrontEnd: functionality testing, performance monitoring, error tracking, user feedback collection.

optimization.build_process: Suggest build process improvements for BrowserFrontEnd. Consider: asset optimization, code minification, caching strategies, deployment automation.
optimization.monitoring: Recommend monitoring setup for BrowserFrontEnd. Include: performance metrics, error tracking, user analytics, uptime monitoring.

updates.content: Plan content update strategy for BrowserFrontEnd. Consider: regular refresh schedule, content accuracy, user engagement, SEO maintenance.
updates.technical: Create technical maintenance schedule for BrowserFrontEnd. Include: dependency updates, security patches, performance reviews, compatibility checks.

monitoring.health_check: Design health check procedures for BrowserFrontEnd. Monitor: page load times, functionality status, error rates, user experience metrics.
monitoring.analytics: Set up analytics tracking for BrowserFrontEnd. Track: user behavior, conversion rates, popular features, performance bottlenecks.
